texts.question:
A {source} {kind} event arrived for the coding agent's session: {summary}{body}{origin}
sourcefed marks it {marked}. Should the agent be shown this event now? Show events that need the agent to do something: CI failures, requested changes, questions or requests addressed to it or its user, merge conflicts, a merged pull request with follow-up work, and new facts that change the work it is doing. Withhold noise: bot comments, approvals, status or assignee changes nobody asked it to act on, thanks, and anything it has already handled. A chat message is noise unless it asks something, gives a task, or adds a fact the work needs: acknowledgements, side remarks and logistics between colleagues ("ok", "on it", "moving this to DM", "which doc?") are noise.
texts.origin: It comes from this session's monitor on {watch}.
